legend: Mammaglobin expression is a hallmark of secretory carcinoma.
S100 shows strong cytoplasmic expression in secretory carcinoma.
Most cases of secretory carcinoma harbour NTRK3 fusion resulting in NTRK protein expression, which can be shown with pan-TRK immunohistochemistry.
Mucin stains such as Alcian blue highlight the extracellular secretions within the microcystic lumina.
ETV6 gene rearrangement can be demonstrated by ETV6 break-apart FISH, showing one intact (yellow) probe and a pair of separated red and green probes (arrows).
Secretory carcinoma may show a vacuolated and clear cell cytology.

legend: An encapsulated neoplasm with focal extracapsular extension into the adjacent lacrimal gland tissue is seen. Neoplastic cells have mildly pleomorphic nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm with occasional intracytoplasmic vacuoles. Neoplastic cells are arranged in microfollicular and cystic patterns with eosinophilic focally vacuolated colloid material in cystic spaces. There is a prominent intralesional haemorrhage.
